title: Queue-amber predicate: the >0 guard exists only in the measure helper, not the draw pass (the red path got both)
evidence: helper (line 602): `if p.q[0] + p.q[1] + p.q[2] > 0 || (amber_pct > 0 && p.util_pct >= u32(amber_pct)) {` — pinned by the new test `testing.expect_value(t, noc_queue_rows(&sr, 0), i32(1))  // amber 0 = only the queued pipe`. Draw pass (line 772): `if p.q[0] + p.q[1] + p.q[2] == 0 && p.util_pct < u32(amber_pct) {` — no amber_pct > 0 guard. Compare the red path, guarded on BOTH sides: helper `if red_pct > 0 && p.util_pct >= u32(red_pct) {` and draw `if cat.balance.warnings.pipe_red_pct <= 0 || p.util_pct < u32(cat.balance.warnings.pipe_red_pct) {`.
detail: At amber_pct == 0 the draw pass draws a queue row for every pipe (u32(0): util < 0 never true) while the measure helper counts only queued pipes — breaking the file's 'MUST agree with draw_noc_panel row-for-row' scroll-clamp contract. Unreachable today (catalog validation enforces pipe_amber_pct >= 1), but the helper's 0-semantics are now test-pinned while the draw side silently differs.
recommended_fix: Mirror the red path: add `amber_pct > 0 &&`-equivalent handling to the draw predicate (e.g. `if p.q[0]+p.q[1]+p.q[2] == 0 && (amber_pct <= 0 || p.util_pct < u32(amber_pct)) { continue }`) so both sites share the pinned semantics.

title: Implementation-spec artifact still lists the removed line_rate_bytes_per_tick and a stale util_pct_window signature
evidence: spec artifact (unchanged by the fix commit — `git diff 48c0e82..1cb1b4b -- _bmad-output/` is empty): "`transit_ticks(pb, cap)`, `line_rate_bps(pb, cap, hz)`, `line_rate_bytes_per_tick(...)` (= frame_bytes/transit — the honest reference), `util_pct_window(served, w, pb, cap)`". Shipped core/units.odin has no line_rate_bytes_per_tick and `util_pct_window :: proc(served_units: u64, window_ticks, capacity: u32) -> u32` (3 params, no pb); the PR body itself states "N8 `line_rate_bytes_per_tick` removed (dead)".
detail: The fix commit updated _pr_body_network_units.md (N8 removal) but not the spec artifact, so the PR's two self-description artifacts now disagree about the shipped units.odin API — the next job reading the spec as the plan will design against a proc that does not exist.
recommended_fix: Update the spec artifact's units.odin design bullet: drop `line_rate_bytes_per_tick(...)` and correct `util_pct_window(served, w, pb, cap)` to `util_pct_window(served, w, cap)`.
